tools.name: bulksms_get_profile
tools.description: Show the BulkSMS account: username, credit balance, credit limit, whether credit transfer is allowed, the daily message quota (size and remaining today) and the sender ids this account may use. Company and billing details are left out. BulkSMS REST: GET /profile.

tools.name: bulksms_list_messages
tools.description: List sent (SENT) and received (RECEIVED) SMS messages, newest first by default. BulkSMS limits the window to the last 7 days unless submission_date_from is given. To page newest-first, pass before_id = the smallest id of the previous page; with sort_order ASCENDING pass after_id = the largest id of

tools.name: bulksms_get_message
tools.description: Get one sent or received message by its id: body, recipient, delivery status, number of parts and credit cost. BulkSMS REST: GET /messages/{id}.

tools.name: bulksms_list_replies
tools.description: List the received (RECEIVED) replies linked to a sent message id. Only messages sent with a REPLIABLE sender have linked replies. An empty list means none or an unknown id. BulkSMS REST: GET /messages/{id}/relatedReceivedMessages.

tools.name: bulksms_list_blocked_numbers
tools.description: List phone numbers the account may not send to (added via the API, by a recipient replying STOP, or by BulkSMS). To page, pass min_id = the largest id of the previous page + 1. BulkSMS REST: GET /blocked-numbers.

tools.name: bulksms_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the account's webhooks (name, trigger SENT/RECEIVED, active flag, invoke option). Only the host of each webhook URL is shown: the path and query can hold a secret. Read-only: webhooks are not changed by this server. BulkSMS REST: GET /webhooks.

tools.name: bulksms_send_message
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS REAL SMS to real people and SPENDS CREDITS from the user's BulkSMS account; it cannot be undone or recalled. tools.name: bulksms_block_number
tools.description: WRITE: adds ONE phone number to the account's blocked list, so that no further messages are sent to it (a send to a blocked number fails with FAILED.BLOCKED and still costs credits). This API has no way to remove a block again: do it only when the user asks for it. BulkSMS REST: POST /blocked-number

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "bulksms_list_webhooks" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bulksms_get_profile, bulksms_list_messages, bulksms_get_message, bulksms_list_replies, bulksms_list_webhooks, bulksms_block_number · Private data: bulksms_list_webhooks, bulksms_send_message · Public sink: bulksms_list_messages, bulksms_list_blocked_numbers, bulksms_list_webhooks, bulksms_send_message, bulksms_block_number · Destructive: bulksms_send_message, bulksms_block_number.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bulksms_get_profile, bulksms_list_messages, bulksms_get_message, bulksms_list_replies, bulksms_list_webhooks, bulksms_block_number · Private data: bulksms_list_webhooks, bulksms_send_message · Public sink: bulksms_list_messages, bulksms_list_blocked_numbers, bulksms_list_webhooks, bulksms_send_message, bulksms_block_number · Destructive: bulksms_send_message, bulksms_block_number

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
